name: breakhis-router-diagnosis-v1
purpose: Diagnose first-step generalization and calibration before choosing a binary intervention
cross_fitting: For each fitting query, remove every case in its conservative group before all support, class weights and head centers
validation: Recompute binary pooling only from the already-saved selected parent validation field probabilities
interpretation: Training-group-out and validation-only descriptive diagnosis, not a new model or a measured97% improvement; no calibration coefficient or threshold search
